blockers: Example.com offers no purchasable product or service.
No pricing, commercial terms, checkout, or provisioning path exists.
No purchase or payment API exists; IANA reports that POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE are unsupported.
IANA states that example.com is reserved for documentation, unavailable for registration or transfer, and unsuitable for operational use (https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains).
trust_events: The site explicitly says to avoid operational use, so I would not attempt to treat it as a real merchant or continue toward payment.
notes: Read-only inspection found only an informational page linking to IANA. Public pricing/API/purchase searches found no commercial offering. IANA confirms the domain is a reserved example domain and its web service is best-effort only: https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains and https://www.iana.org/news/2024/example-domain-http-methods
